'''Lazu Lirona''' was a [[smuggler]] who was active during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. Her former occupation was a track star on [[Gavriza]], but she fell ill with [[pneumogray]], which ended her career. Lirona started a courier business, but later turned to smuggling innocuous items affected by tariff or license restrictions.<ref name="TROSVD" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' places the [[Battle of Exegol]] one year after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places in [[34 ABY]], therefore putting the battle in [[35 ABY]].</ref> Lirona participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]] as part of [[Citizens' Fleet|the fleet]] the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' gathered from the [[Core Worlds]]. After the battle, she traveled to the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the moon [[Ajan Kloss]] and joined their victory celebrations.<ref name="TROS" />
